test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 22 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Kalki is an immediate neighbour of both Oorja and Namita. Leela is sitting second to the left of Oorja. Padma is sitting second to the right of Kalki. Madhuri is sitting third to the right of Namita. Who is an immediate neighbour of both Kalki and Padma?
solution: **Given:** Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) Leela is sitting second to the left of Oorja. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a14bd7d2577a8022b36ddc897b0c25b8f8971930e0e2ecbadceb84bc4daaf380.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d52306ccd14b6f59c5c067338f06538bd1a34b48c1254884b6643c01f9302051.png] 2) Kalki is an immediate neighbour of both Oorja and Namita. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c621f4041a9d4c7cdd4f65aedbc98e59fb6a4a051a5d79962a2e23a7a31b566a.png]
